propositions: managed_refs cannot distinguish a brand-new never-pushed local link from a peer-deleted one due to strict monotonicity marking refs as managed at creation time
outbound ADD dedup on (vendor_type, target_key) is direction-agnostic and not relation-keyed, allowing local links with colliding vendor types to never be pushed and lack G4 protection from removal
inbound removal records for never-pushed local links can reach the applier and incorrectly remove links the peer never carried

the fix persists durable peer-confirmation records keyed by (source_local_id, target_local_id, relation) in .bridge_state/peer_confirmations.json, confirming links only after successful outbound ADD or observation in authoritative snapshots
removal records are declined and logged for managed-but-never-peer-confirmed links while removals of peer-confirmed links continue to converge
completeness is a trichotomy: absent issuelinks means unobserved, empty list means authoritatively empty, and populated data is evidence—partial/failed reads never confirm or deny deletion
